item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Cricket fraternity reacts as Sanju Samson’s record-breaking 89 powers India to 255/5 in final vs New Zealand
item.description: India opener Sanju Samson produced a sensational knock in the T20 World Cup 2026 final against New Zealand in Ahmedabad, smashing 89 off just 46 balls to register the highest individual score in the tournament summit clash. item.title: “My accountability is not for people on Social Media”: Gautam Gambhir’s blunt verdict after guiding India to T20 World Cup win
item.description: India thrashed New Zealand by 96 runs in the final at Narendra Modi Stadium on Sunday (March 8) to successfully defend their T20 World Cup crown on home soil. Following the triumph, India head coach Gautam Gambhir was at his blunt best as he spoke about being accountable to people in the dressing room and not towards people on social media.
